mapper.select: SELECT d.NAME, d.serial_number, d.type_name, d.norms, d.price, d.number, d.receive_dep_name, d.receive_user_id, b.check_user_id, c.check_time, c.check_status, c.create_by, c.creator_id, c.creator_type, d.status, d.unit, d.start_time, d.usage_time, d.usage_date, c.abnormal_type, c.abnormal_remarks, c.abnormal_file FROM property_check_plan a INNER JOIN property_check_task b ON a.id = b.plan_id INNER JOIN property_check_task_relation c ON b.id = c.task_id INNER JOIN property_detailed d ON c.property_id = d.id WHERE a.id = #{planId}

SELECT d.`name`, d.serial_number, d.type_name, d.norms, d.price, d.number, d.receive_dep_name, d.receive_user_id as receiveUserName, b.check_user_id as checkUserName, c.check_time, c.check_status, c.creator_id, c.creator_type, c.create_by as createByName, c.abnormal_type, c.abnormal_remarks, d.usage_date, d.start_time, d.unit FROM property_check_plan a INNER JOIN property_check_task b ON a.id = b.plan_id INNER JOIN property_check_task_relation c ON b.id = c.task_id INNER JOIN property_detailed d ON c.property_id = d.id WHERE a.id = #{planId}

SELECT a.id, a.check_user_id, a.status, b.task_name, b.duty_user_id, a.check_total_number, a.estimate_end_time, a.reality_end_time, a.check_complete_number, a.check_win_number, a.check_loss_number FROM property_check_task a INNER JOIN property_check_plan b ON a.plan_id = b.id WHERE b.id = #{planId} order by a.create_time desc
select sum(check_complete_number) as check_complete_number, sum(check_win_number) as check_win_number, sum(check_loss_number) as check_loss_number from property_check_task where plan_id = #{planId}

SELECT a.id, a.status, b.task_name, b.duty_user_id, a.check_total_number, a.estimate_end_time, a.reality_end_time, a.check_complete_number, a.check_win_number, a.check_loss_number FROM property_check_task a INNER JOIN property_check_plan b ON a.plan_id = b.id where a.id = #{taskId}

SELECT b.id, b.`status`, b.`name`, b.serial_number, b.type_name, b.purchase_date, b.receive_dep_name, b.receive_user_id, b.imgs as imgsStr FROM property_check_task_relation a INNER JOIN property_detailed b ON a.property_id = b.id WHERE a.task_id = #{taskId}
and a.check_status=#{taskStatus}

SELECT sum(check_total_number) as check_total_number, sum(check_complete_number) as check_complete_number, sum(check_win_number) as check_win_number, sum(check_loss_number) as check_loss_number, sum(abnormal_number) as abnormal_number FROM `property_check_task` where plan_id = #{planId}
select choose_type from property_check_plan a inner join property_check_task b on a.id = b.plan_id where b.id = #{taskId}
